direct_answer: This **UML Class Diagram** models an E-Commerce domain with **9 core classes**: Use Case diagram of an Online Shopping System, <<Service> >, <Subsystem >, Registered, Identity, Web, New, PayPal, Use Case Diagrams. 1) **Class Responsibilities**: Each class encapsulates distinct domain responsibilities — **Use Case diagram of an Online Shopping System** (state attributes, methods); **<<Service> >** (attributes [Authentication], methods); **<Subsystem >** (attributes [Online Shopping, View Items, <<include> >], methods); **Registered** (attributes [customer], methods). 2) **Whole-Part Coupling**: The core fulfillment lifecycle couples **Delivery** to **Order** (`1..1`) and **Payment**, ensuring atomic order dispatch. 3) **Catalog Aggregation**: **Order** and **Product** maintain aggregation references with **Items**, decoupling catalog inventory from active shopping carts. 4) **Multiplicity & Interactions**: Multiplicity constraints like `1..1` (Order to Delivery) and `1..*` (Customer to Orders) govern transactional integrity, while action dependencies reflect operational workflows (Customer *Pays* via Payment, Seller *Collects* revenue, Customer *Selects* Products).
